title: Vineberry cluster
content:
# Vineberry cluster

Type: Food | Internal ID: Vineberry | Source: Ashlands | Usage: Crafting, Eating, Farming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 30 | Max Stamina: 30 | Max Eitr: 30 | Duration: 15m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Vineberries are food grown from Ashvine. They can be eaten raw, but are more useful in Cauldron recipes.

## Availability

• They be found on Ashvine clusters growing on the sides of Charred ruins in the Ashlands biome.
• Ashvine can be farmed with Vineberry seeds.

## Usage

• Can be eaten directly, but the Health, Stamina, and Eitr provided are far inferior to other foods available in its tier.
